password.label: New password
password.help: Ends all of the user's sessions.

expire.title: Expire the password?
expire.body: The current password stops opening the account until the user resets it or you set a new one. Their sessions are kept. If the realm sends email, signing in with it sends them a reset link.

resetLink.title: Make a reset link
resetLink.body: A one-time link for the user to choose a new password, for when their email can't be reached. Nothing is sent. Whoever holds the link can take the account: hand it over by a channel you trust.
resetLink.redirectHelp: An address within the realm's allowed redirects.

email.help: Takes effect at once; both addresses are told.

erase.title: Delete {email}
erase.body: Erasing a user is irreversible: the account becomes a tombstone, their sign-ins and sessions are deleted, and each collection's policy is applied to what they own.
erase.reportFailed: What the user owns could not be checked.
erase.withoutPolicy: Collections without a policy are left alone: {names}
erase.none: The user owns nothing under a policy.
erase.deactivateHint: To keep the data, disable the user instead.

expire.body: The password of {accounts} accounts stops working. Users choose a new one with a reset; a sign-in with the old one sends them the email. This can't be undone.

tell.title: Tell the users?
tell.body: Emails every user whose password was expired a link to choose a new one. Users already told are skipped, and the email limits apply. It runs as a job you can follow in the jobs list.

revoke.title: End every session?
revoke.body: Everyone, including you, signs in again. Passwords are not touched.
revoke.mismatch: Type the realm name, {realm}, to confirm.

start.body: Every stored document, including those in the trash, is read and validated against the current schema. Nothing is changed.
start.warning: This reads every document, so on a big collection it can take a long time and loads the database. It runs in the background: you can leave this page. Only one check runs at a time.

report.clean: Every document read matches the schema.

rerun.body: A new job is queued with the same function, input and caller. The original keeps its result.
